title: URMA-CRTI Rolling Element Bearing Vibration Dataset

source.licenseEvidence: Per-dataset manifest in BearingDatasets identifies CC BY 4.0; recheck Zenodo record metadata at download time.
source.citation: Oudjani, B. (2026). URMA-CRTI dataset for rolling element bearing vibration data. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19109150

caveats: Signal unit is not stated; do not assume g or m/s².
Metadata describes three accelerometers but the normalized source says one signal per recording; verify channel mapping before use.
Research benchmark only; not a universal bearing diagnostic threshold or field validation.

download.reason: The primary Zenodo license metadata has not been independently confirmed; the third-party manifest claim is not sufficient.
